description:
Recapd finds your event photos for you.

Open the event and Recapd scans your camera roll for every photo and video taken during the event hours. They are already selected. Tap share once and they are in the album. No scrolling, no picking, nothing missed.

Built for every kind of get-together: weddings, birthdays, parties, Halloween, Christmas parties, Easter, New Year's Eve, graduations, bachelorette and bachelor parties, corporate events, festivals, holidays and trips.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Create an event and pick the time window.
2. Guests scan the QR code or open the link. No app and no account needed, a first name is enough.
3. Everyone's photos land in one shared album, in full resolution.
4. Download the whole album before it deletes itself.

WHY HOSTS USE RECAPD
- Automatic photo finding: only the shots from the event hours, preselected for you
- Guests join from the browser by QR code or a 6-letter code
- Full resolution photos and videos, not chat-app compression
- Uploads keep going with the phone locked, hundreds of photos at once
- Download every photo and video in one tap
- Private: invite only, no public feed, no followers, no likes
- Albums delete themselves 14 days after the event

NEW
- Event info: location, dress code, schedule, a live countdown and add to calendar
- Built-in camera: shoot photos and videos that go straight into the event album

FREE AND PRO
The free plan covers small events. Pro lifts the limits for big days with more guests, longer videos and more storage.
